label: For "KYC Document Verification (Vision)": Verify ID documents in under 3 seconds with tamper, forgery and replay detection to cut manual KYC review by 80%. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Synthetic forgeries in training differ from real attacker craft.
